name: m4-forkvar-baseline
description: Fork-to-fork variance, 2.13.18 vs `scala2-perf-integration`: 10 forks per build and corpus, interleaved. Read each variant's spread across forks (CV of score, cycles, instructions, alloc), not only Δ.

Warmup from `m4-forkvar-pilot`: scala time flattens by about iteration 7 (compilations still ~150/iteration, never zero), re2s by about 40. No JIT recording, so these are the undisturbed spreads; `m4-forkvar-jit` repeats scala with it. Patched JDK 26, 8G heap, `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`, `xctrace:ipc`.
